questions.q: A method has OWA = 0.90. What does it mean?
options: It is about 10% better than Naive2 on the combined score
It is the best in the competition
why: OWA is not an accuracy percentage.
Correct: below 1 is better than Naive2.
A value above 1 would be worse.
The winner had a lower OWA (about 0.82).

A single average for all series
why: Slow and ignores price and promotion information.
Correct.
Weak baseline.
